manual_expected_inventory.project: Hillside Village, 89 N. Meadows Road, Medfield, MA
manual_expected_inventory.scope: A-2 Second Floor Plan sheet from the public 9-page plan/elevation set.
minimum_expected_evidence: The sheet is a residential second-floor plan.
The sheet contains residential room labels, door/opening labels, vertical circulation hints, and dimension text.
The current recognizer does not expose horizontal circulation for this sheet, so this expected inventory does not require that signal.
annotation_basis: Public Medfield plan/elevation PDF previously retrieved as a 9-page source.
P55 page-5 A-2 run artifact inspection.
This expected spec is a recognition benchmark, not a complete permit-review inventory.

authoring_note: Human-reviewed expected inventory for the real Medfield A-2 second-floor plan. Passing this benchmark means the recognizer can produce a stable component inventory for this sheet with the recorded real-CAD noise floor; it is not a GB compliance-accuracy claim.

expected_rule_counts._note: Adversarial expected_rule_counts seeded by M5.Z-W4.B + W5.A to provide honest reviewer ground truth that exceeds detection. Per-case counts are reviewer-judgment estimates for residential plans (e.g. ~15 corridor-width violations per floor on old buildings, ~5 bedroom-area near-misses per case). These are reviewer-level estimates, NOT per-instance labels.
